root <- getwd()

## Objective

The fitting half of Phase 4 (D-101). This notebook fits every BAG model
that `09_bag.qmd` reads, and nothing else:

- the **main fits**: stage × season, timing and pre-trend models, their
  variants, the gear contrast and the fleet-size refits;
- the **random-field check** fits (D-077), when `field_check` is true;
- the **leave-one-vessel-out** refits (step 8).

Every model is defined once, in `r/bag_specs.R`, with its parameters in
`r/bag_params.yml`; 09b (power) and 09 (the report) source the same files,
so all three compute the same cache keys. Fits are cached in
`data/processed/models/{pipeline}/` and refits in
`reports/bag/{pipeline}/cache/`, so an interrupted run resumes where it
stopped. Each fit's start, end, time and memory are appended to
`reports/bag/{pipeline}/fit_progress.log` as it runs (D-099).

Render this before `09_bag.qmd`; the report stops on any fit that is
missing. Run it from a terminal, not inside an editor session, since a
cold run takes hours:
`quarto render r/09a_bag_fit.qmd -P pipeline:v5`.

## Specifications

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(sf)
  library(sdmTMB)
})

source("r/paths.R")
source("r/gfw_helpers.R")
source("r/analysis_helpers.R")
source("r/bag_helpers.R")

doc_params <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params else {
  hdr <- knitr::knit_params(readLines(file.path(root, "r/09a_bag_fit.qmd"), warn = FALSE))
  lapply(hdr, function(p) p$value)
}
# every table, spec and runner; sets qparams and paths (D-101). Evaluated
# where this notebook's own code runs, as when it was part of 10_bag.qmd
source("r/bag_specs.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

tab_dir <- file.path(paths$bag, "tables")
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
outputs <- character()
save_tab <- function(df, name) {
  f <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, ".csv"))
  write_csv(df, f, na = "")
  outputs <<- c(outputs, f)
  invisible(f)
}

# a test run: only the specs whose id matches fit_only
test_run <- nzchar(qparams$fit_only)
if (test_run) {
  all_specs <- keep(all_specs, \(s) grepl(qparams$fit_only, s$id))
  field_specs <- keep(field_specs, \(s) grepl(qparams$fit_only, s$id))
  message("test run (fit_only = '", qparams$fit_only, "'): ", length(all_specs), " main and ",
          length(field_specs), " field-check specs; leave-one-vessel-out skipped")
}
tibble(set = c("main fits", "random-field check", "power bases (09b)"),
       specs = c(length(all_specs), if (isTRUE(qparams$field_check)) length(field_specs) else 0L,
                 length(power_specs))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Main fits (parallel)

Every main specification not yet cached is fitted here, up to
`r qparams$fit_workers` at a time, each in its own R process. Of those, at
most `r qparams$heavy_workers` are large fits (over
`r format(qparams$heavy_rows, big.mark = ",")` rows: the monthly timing
and pre-trend models), which set the run's peak memory (D-097). The timing
models' leads, fleet and no-field variants wait for the main timing fit and
start from its estimates (D-097). A fit that fails stops the render with its
error.

```{r}
t_fit <- system.time(fit_peaks <- run_specs(all_specs, qparams$fit_workers))[["elapsed"]]
round(t_fit / 60, 1)

# per fit: time, convergence, optimiser iterations (to see what the warm
# starts save), whether it was warm-started, and its peak memory when it
# was fitted in this render (NA when it came from the cache)
fit_log <- map_dfr(all_specs, function(s) {
  f <- as.character(fit_cache_path(s$key, paths$models))
  m <- jsonlite::read_json(paste0(f, ".json"))
  fit <- readRDS(f)
  # mesh_vertices: a check on the cutoff (D-098); at 2 km a full-grid
  # model has several hundred, not one per cell
  tibble(model = s$id, rows = nrow(s$key$data), fit_minutes = round(m$fit_seconds / 60, 1),
         converged = fit_ok(fit), iterations = fit$model$iterations %||% NA_integer_,
         warm_start = !is.null(s$after), mesh_vertices = fit$spde$mesh$n)
})
# a test run may select none, and an empty table has no column to join on
if (nrow(fit_log) > 0) fit_log <- left_join(fit_log, fit_peaks, by = "model")
if (!test_run) save_tab(fit_log, "bag_fit_log")
fit_log |> knitr::kable()
```

## Random-field check fits (D-077)

The spatial-block cross-validation of the stage × season models' fields
(three structures each, five folds per job) and the timing models without
their AR1 year field. Fitted only when `field_check` is true
(`r isTRUE(qparams$field_check)` here); the report reads them on the same
condition.

```{r field-check, eval = isTRUE(get0("qparams")$field_check)}
t_field <- system.time(field_peaks <- run_specs(field_specs, qparams$fit_workers))[["elapsed"]]
round(t_field / 60, 1)
# fit times of the new jobs (the CV jobs are 5 fits each), whether each was
# warm-started (D-097), and peak memory when fitted in this render
field_log <- map_dfr(field_specs, function(s) {
  m <- jsonlite::read_json(paste0(as.character(fit_cache_path(s$key, paths$models)), ".json"))
  tibble(model = s$id, rows = nrow(s$key$data), fit_minutes = round(m$fit_seconds / 60, 1),
         warm_start = !is.null(s$after))
})
# a test run may select none, and an empty table has no column to join on
if (nrow(field_log) > 0) field_log <- left_join(field_log, field_peaks, by = "model")
if (!test_run) save_tab(field_log, "bag_field_fit_log")
field_log |> knitr::kable()
```

## Leave-one-vessel-out refits (step 8)

The headline stage × season model refitted without each of the top
`r qparams$lovo_top_k` vessels per dataset × gear, and without BUCKEYE
(368175660), as `r qparams$workers` separate R processes. Each refit's result
is a small file in `reports/bag/{pipeline}/cache/`; the report reads them
and attaches the vessels' names. Skipped in a test run.

```{r}
if (!test_run) {
  lovo <- lovo_refits()
  lovo |> group_by(id) |>
    summarise(refits = n(), converged = sum(!is.na(estimate)), .groups = "drop") |>
    knitr::kable()
}
```

## Manifest and provenance

```{r}
if (!test_run) {
  manifest <- tibble(file = outputs, sha256 = map_chr(outputs, file_sha256))
  f_manifest <- file.path(paths$bag, "manifest_09a.csv")
  write_csv(manifest, f_manifest)
  write_provenance(f_manifest, c(input_files, bag_params_file), extra = list(
    outputs = nrow(manifest), main_fits = length(all_specs),
    field_fits = if (isTRUE(qparams$field_check)) length(field_specs) else 0L,
    interim_spec = "sdmTMB; spatial on; iid stage fields (stage x season); ar1 year fields (timing)",
    mesh_cutoff_km = qparams$mesh_cutoff_km, sdmTMB = as.character(packageVersion("sdmTMB"))))
  nrow(manifest)
}
```
